prompt:
Fix snippets/pickup-availability-list-2.liquid so that it renders a store-pickup availability block exactly as specified. Inputs (all top-level variables, always supplied): - heading: string or null. - locations: array or null. Each item is an object that always has these keys: name (string), available (boolean), pickup_time (string or null). Output rules: 1. If locations is null or has 0 items, output nothing (empty string). 2. Otherwise output a wrapper
...
. 3. Optional heading: only when heading is not null and is non-empty after stripping leading/trailing whitespace, the first child is

HEADING

, where HEADING is the stripped heading, HTML-escaped. Otherwise there is no h3 at all. 4. A location is available only when its available value is true. If there are no available locations, output

Pickup currently unavailable

(and no ul). 5. Otherwise output
    containing one
  • for each of the FIRST 3 available locations in input order (unavailable locations are skipped and do not count toward the 3). Each li is
  • NAMETIME
    • , where NAME is the HTML-escaped name, and TIME is PICKUP only when pickup_time is not null and non-empty after stripping (PICKUP = stripped, HTML-escaped pickup_time); otherwise TIME is nothing (no empty span). 6. If more than 3 locations are available, directly after
output

+N more locations

, where N is the number of available locations not shown; when N is 1 the word is singular: +1 more location. 7. Output contains no whitespace or newlines between or around tags; text appears exactly as described. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/pickup-availability-list-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
